title: Brutal Drinks Pina Colada 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Pina Colada Nic Salt e-liquid evokes a smooth, sophisticated tropical cocktail with its velvety and refreshing flavours of sweet Pineapple and creamy Coconut. Perfectly balanced to deliver a vibrant burst of fruitiness with a silky finish, this flavour is ideal for fans of drink-inspired blends. Crafted by the expert mixologists at Just Juice, Brutal Drinks Nic Salts offer intense, fruit-inspired drink flavours in a smooth nicotine salt format. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, providing satisfying nicotine relief with a soft throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Pina Colada is perfect for vapers seeking bold, tropical flavours in a versatile and convenient format. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection from Just Juice, this e-liquid joins an exciting line-up of refreshing drink-inspired blends, including Mango Lassi, Frozen Mojito, and Brutal Bull. Explore the range to discover your new favourite vape.
